encoding.owners: The dashboard_owner marker of a view: folder is the folder view extra (authoritative), collab is the database collab mirror views[view_id].dashboard_owner. A view missing from owners has neither.
encoding.readDashboardOwner: readDashboardOwner(folder, collab): folder when it is a non-empty string, else collab when it is a non-empty string, else null.
encoding.filterOwnedTabViewIds: filterOwnedTabViewIds(ids, openedViewId, isOwned) with isOwned(id) = readDashboardOwner(owners[id].folder, owners[id].collab) != null: [openedViewId] when the opened view is owned (even when ids lacks it), else ids without the owned views, in order. It applies only to tab lists derived from folder children, never to an explicit host list.

ownerCases.name: the collab mirror is read when the folder has none
an empty folder marker is ignored
a folder marker that is not a string is ignored

cases.name: owned views are hidden and the order is kept
opening an owned view shows it as the only tab
an opened owned view missing from the children is still its only tab
a view owned only through the collab mirror is hidden
empty markers do not hide a view
an opened view that is not owned is not added
